verdict.rationale: Blink documents local 'Hosts' profiles (blink-shell-docs-11) but no evidence describes any cross-device sync mechanism (iCloud, Dropbox, cloud backup, etc.). A community comment explicitly requests config sync via iCloud/Dropbox because 'it's quite a pain to sync host lists across several iOS devices' (blink-shell-comm-9), indicating the capability is absent rather than delivered.
